cohort: The study cohort consisted of 7 extremely premature infants (born at less than 28 weeks' gestation) diagnosed with symptomatic intestinal malrotation in a single tertiary neonatal intensive care unit between 2010 and 2020.
finding: Symptomatic intestinal malrotation has a relatively high prevalence (1.4%) in extremely premature infants and often presents atypically with marked abdominal distension but without bilious vomiting.
